grammarItem: X は Y です (Topic and Noun Predicate)
instructionalDetails: Topic marker は (pronounced wa); noun predicate with です; contextual omission of understood topic; nouns lack gender/article/number marking.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 41-42 (PDF pp. 49-50, review-g1-49.png, review-g1-50.png). Verified topic omission, noun predicate, and particle wa.

grammarItem: Question Sentences with か (Interrogative Particle)
instructionalDetails: Sentence-final particle か forms questions without word order change or rising pitch markers; answers with はい and いいえ.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 42 (PDF p. 50). Verified yes/no questions with はい/いいえ, question word 何 (なん before です/counters, なに before particles), and punctuation omission of ?.

grammarItem: Noun の Noun (Noun Modification & Possession)
instructionalDetails: の links two nouns where the first restricts or modifies the second (possession, affiliation, category).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 43 (PDF p. 51). Verified Noun1 (modifier/restriction) + の + Noun2 (main idea), possession, affiliation, and chained noun clauses.

grammarItem: Time and Age Counters (時・分・歳・半)
instructionalDetails: Hours (何時, 四時, 七時, 九時), minutes with phonological shifts (一分, 三分, 四分, 六分, 八分, 十分じゅっぷん), ages (一歳, 八歳, 十歳, 二十歳はたち), and 半.
evidence: Audited in 2026-11-17 supervision pass. Verified minute sound changes, contrast between じゅっぷん and じゅうぶん.

grammarItem: Demonstrative Pronouns (これ・それ・あれ・どれ)
instructionalDetails: Ko-so-a-do series pointing to proximity to speaker, listener, or distance from both, and question word どれ.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 60 (PDF p. 68). Verified proximity zones (kore/sore/are), question word dore taking ga not wa, and politeness rule avoiding re-series for people in earshot.

grammarItem: Demonstrative Modifiers (この・その・あの・どの + Noun)
instructionalDetails: Adnominal series directly modifying nouns; cannot stand alone as independent pronouns.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 61 (PDF p. 69). Verified adnominal modifier requirement (+ Noun), polite human reference (kono gakusee/kata), and question word dono taking ga.

grammarItem: Place Demonstratives (ここ・そこ・あそこ・どこ)
instructionalDetails: Location demonstratives pointing to speaker space, listener space, or distant location.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 62 (PDF p. 70). Verified location demonstratives koko, soko, asoko, doko and asking directions with wa doko desu ka.

grammarItem: だれの Noun (Interrogative Possessive)
instructionalDetails: Asking for ownership/affiliation; answers with Noun の (possessive pronoun omission).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 62, 64 (PDF pp. 70, 72). Verified dare no Noun asking ownership, noun omission after no in replies, and sentence particles ne (agreement) and yo (informing).

grammarItem: Noun も (Inclusive Particle 'Also/Too')
instructionalDetails: Replaces は/が/を to indicate similarity with previously established predicate.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 62-63 (PDF pp. 70-71). Verified particle mo replacing wa/ga/o, strict positioning after the shared-property entity, and demo restriction for secondary attributes.

grammarItem: Noun じゃないです / じゃありません (Negative Noun Predicate)
instructionalDetails: Colloquial negative じゃないです versus formal じゃありません / ではありません.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 63-64 (PDF pp. 71-72). Verified negative noun predicate registers (janai desu, jaarimasen, dewa arimasen), ban on negating i-adjectives with janai desu, and ban on isolated desu/janai in short replies.

grammarItem: Verb Conjugation: Ru-verbs, U-verbs, Irregular verbs
instructionalDetails: Three verb groups; polite non-past affirmative 〜ます and negative 〜ません; vowel base shifts.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 86-88 (PDF pp. 94-96). Verified Ru-verb vs U-verb vs Irregular classification, u-to-i base shift, and irregular u-verb exception kaeru.

grammarItem: Particles を, で, に, へ (Object, Means/Location of Action, Time, Goal)
instructionalDetails: を direct object; で location of action/means; に specific time/goal; へ direction.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 88-90 (PDF pp. 96-98). Verified object marker o (pronounced o), dynamic action location de, goal ni/he (pronounced e), and flexible word order.

grammarItem: Time References: Numerical Time vs Relative Time (に Usage)
instructionalDetails: Days of week and specific numbers take に; relative words (今日, 明日, 毎日) do not take に.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 89-90 (PDF pp. 97-98). Verified time marker ni with days of week/specific numbers, and strict ban on ni with relative time words (kyoo, ashita, kinook, maiasa, itsu).

grammarItem: 〜ませんか (Polite Invitation)
instructionalDetails: Negative question functioning as an invitation ('Won't you...?').
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 90 (PDF p. 98). Verified negative question masenka as polite invitation, distinction from factual affirmative masuka, and polite soft refusal with chotto.

grammarItem: Frequency Adverbs (毎日・よく・時々・あまり・全然)
instructionalDetails: Positive adverbs (よく, 時々) vs negative polarity adverbs requiring negative predicate (あまり, 全然).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 91 (PDF p. 99). Verified positive frequency adverbs (mainichi, yoku, tokidoki) vs negative polarity adverbs (amari, zenzen requiring negative predicates).

grammarItem: Past Tense of Verbs and です (〜ました・〜ませんでした・〜でした)
instructionalDetails: Past affirmative 〜ました, negative 〜ませんでした. Copula past affirmative でした, negative じゃありませんでした / じゃなかったです / ではありませんでした.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 110-111 (PDF pp. 118-119). Verified past forms for ru-verbs, u-verbs, irregulars, and three negative registers of past copula.

grammarItem: Location Words (上・下・前・後ろ・中・隣・近く・間)
instructionalDetails: Relative position formula X は Y の [位置] にあります/います. Adjacent neighbor となり (same category only) vs そば/よこ/近く. Dynamic actions taking で.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 106, 108-109 (PDF pp. 114, 116-117). Verified 10 spatial relational nouns, tonari same-category constraint, and dynamic action de.

grammarItem: あります and います (Existence, Possession, and Events)
instructionalDetails: Inanimate あります vs animate います. Station location takes に. Event taking place takes で (お祭りがあります). Negative possession (テレビがありません) vs negative copula.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 107-108 (PDF pp. 115-116). Verified animate/inanimate distinction, stationary に vs event de, and possession.

grammarItem: Duration, Quantities, and Particle と
instructionalDetails: Duration expressed as bare noun without に (一時間). Particle と connecting nouns (A と B) and companion (together with). Particle も combinations (にも, へも, でも).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 111-113 (PDF pp. 119-121). Verified duration bare noun rule, particle to dual functions, and compound particle mo combinations.

grammarItem: Adjectives Conjugation & Noun Modification (い-adjectives & な-adjectives)
instructionalDetails: 4-quadrant conjugation matrix for present/past x affirmative/negative. Irregular adjective いい (forms based on よい). Noun modification (い-adj direct, な-adj + な). Isogashii restricted to people.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 132-134 (PDF pp. 140-142). Verified i-adj and na-adj conjugation rules, irregular ii->yoi shift, noun modification with na, and person-only isogashii constraint.

grammarItem: 好き（な） and 嫌い（な） (Likes and Dislikes with が)
instructionalDetails: Grammatically na-adjectives taking particle が for target object. Contrast particle は replacement. Intensified daisuki/daikirai vs totemo suki. Neutral suki demo kirai demo nai.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 135 (PDF p. 143). Verified na-adj status, target marking with ga, contrastive wa substitution, and intensified/neutral forms.

grammarItem: 〜ましょう and 〜ましょうか (Let's and Shall We?)
instructionalDetails: Verb stem + ましょう (enthusiastic proposal/let's). Verb stem + ましょうか (shall we / offering assistance).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 136 (PDF p. 144). Verified mashou for let's and mashou ka for mutual suggestion and offering personal assistance.

grammarItem: Counting and Number Word Position (枚 and Item Order)
instructionalDetails: Flat item counter 枚 (まい). Number word positioning after item + を in sentences (Tシャツを三枚買いました). General counters hitotsu, futatsu, mittsu.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 136 (PDF p. 144). Verified flat object counter mai, word order item + o + quantity + verb, and general native counters.

grammarItem: Te-form Conjugation, Sequence of Actions, and Prohibition (〜てはいけません)
instructionalDetails: 5 sub-rules for u-verbs, ru-verbs, irregulars (suru/kuru), and exception iku->itte. Sequential action chaining with te-form (verbs cannot take particle to). Strong prohibition with te wa ikemasen.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 150-152 (PDF pp. 158-160). Verified 5 u-verb sub-rules, exception iku->itte, sequential te-chaining, and prohibition te wa ikemasen.

grammarItem: 〜てください (Polite Request)
instructionalDetails: V-te + kudasai for polite request/instruction. Bare te-form for close friends/family. Register advice for superiors.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 151 (PDF p. 159). Verified te kudasai instruction/request and bare te-form informal requests.

grammarItem: 〜てもいいですか and 〜てもいいです (Permission)
instructionalDetails: Asking permission (te mo ii desu ka) and granting permission (te mo ii desu / hai, ii desu yo / doozo). Ban on isolated *te mo ii desu without verb. Spoken omission of mo.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 152 (PDF p. 160). Verified asking/granting permission, graceful replies with doozo, and ban on isolated short answers.

grammarItem: 〜から (Reason Clause Linker)
instructionalDetails: [Explanation] から、[Situation]. Explaining causes and reasons. Sentence ordering variants (explanation first vs situation first).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 153 (PDF p. 161). Verified kara clause linking, explanation-situation order, and polite desu kara.

grammarItem: 〜ている (Action in Progress vs Resultant State)
instructionalDetails: Activity verbs (continuous action/occupation) vs change verbs (instantaneous change resulting in state: 結婚している, 座っている, 持っている, 太っている, 住んでいる). Movement verbs 行く/来る indicating prior arrival. Negative of 知る strictly 知りません.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 170-172 (PDF pp. 178-180). Verified duration vs change classification, occupation reading, result of change, and shiru negative rule.

grammarItem: Describing People (Person は Body Part が [Adjective] です)
instructionalDetails: Idiomatic description of physical appearance. Collocations: 背が高い/低い, 頭がいい, 目がいい/悪い.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 172-173 (PDF pp. 180-181). Verified body part topic/subject formula and idiomatic height/intelligence collocations.

grammarItem: Adjective and Noun Te-forms for Joining Sentences (〜くて / 〜で)
instructionalDetails: い-adjective drop い + くて (irregular いい -> よくて). な-adjective and Noun + で. Final predicate tense dictates sentence tense.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 173 (PDF p. 181). Verified i-adj kute, irregular ii->yokute, na-adj/noun de, and final predicate tense agreement.

grammarItem: Verb Stem + に行く / に来る (Movement Purpose)
instructionalDetails: Destination に/へ + V-stem に + 行く/来る/帰る. Activity noun replacement (買い物に行く).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 174 (PDF p. 182). Verified destination markers ni/he, verb stem before purpose ni, and activity nouns.

grammarItem: Counting People (一人, 二人, 四人, etc.)
instructionalDetails: People counter 人. Irregulars: ひとり, ふたり, よにん (ban on shinin/yonnin). Positioning after particle (が一人います).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 174-175 (PDF pp. 182-183). Verified irregular people counts hitori, futari, yonin, and interrogative nannin.

grammarItem: Short Forms and Quoted Speech (〜と思う / 〜と言う)
instructionalDetails: Plain present negative conjugation (ru-verbs, u-verbs ending in u taking wanai, irregulars, aru->nai). Quoted speech formula [Short Form] + to omoimasu / to iimashita. Mandatory だ after nouns/na-adjectives before と. Thought negation preference (〜nai to omoimasu).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 190-194 (PDF pp. 198-202). Verified short form paradigm, irregular negative aru->nai, quotation particle to, mandatory da before to, and inner thought negation.

grammarItem: 〜ないでください (Negative Request)
instructionalDetails: V-short negative + でください. Polite negative request/instruction on signs and exams.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 194 (PDF p. 202). Verified V-nai de kudasai formation, courteous prohibition, and sign instructions.

grammarItem: 動詞の「の」名詞化 (Verb Nominalization: のが好き / 上手 / 下手)
instructionalDetails: Turns action verb into noun phrase using nominalizer の: V-dictionary form + のが好き / 上手 / 下手. Internal object takes を.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 195 (PDF p. 203). Verified nominalizer no, internal clause object particle o retention, and evaluative adjectives.

grammarItem: が vs は (Subject Selection) and 何か・何も (Indefinite Pronouns)
instructionalDetails: Question words as subjects strictly take が (dare ga, nani ga). Answering subject takes が. 何か (something/anything) and 何も + negative (nothing). Omission of particles は/が/を after nanika/nanimo.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 195-196 (PDF pp. 203-204). Verified question word subject ga rule, answering subject ga rule, and indefinite pronouns nanika/nanimo particle dropping.

grammarItem: もう〜ました vs まだ〜ていません (Already Done vs Have Not Yet Done)
instructionalDetails: Affirmative mou + V-mashita (action already completed). Negative mada + V-te imasen (action not yet done). Critical ban on *mada V-masen deshita (past negative is strictly for closed past timeframes, not ongoing uncompleted actions).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 217 (PDF p. 225). Verified mou + past affirmative, mada + te imasen, and ban on past negative with mada.

grammarItem: Past Short Forms and Relative Clauses (Qualifying Nouns with Sentences)
instructionalDetails: Past short form paradigm (verbs te/de -> ta/da, nai -> nakatta; i-adj katta/kunakatta; na-adj & nouns datta/janakatta). Retention of datta in informal past speech. Noun-modifying relative clauses strictly preceding nouns without relative pronouns, with short-form predicates. No tense backshift in reported speech.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 214-218 (PDF pp. 222-226). Verified past short form paradigm, noun-modifying relative clauses without relative pronouns, and absence of sequence-of-tense shift in reported speech.

grammarItem: 〜あまり / 〜のあまり (Excess of Emotion or State)
instructionalDetails: Extreme degree of feeling or state leading to an unusual or adverse outcome beyond normal expectations.
evidence: Audited in N2 review pass. Broadened nuance from narrow emotion to general excess; quiz prompt rewritten to test natural excess (あまりの緊張から).

grammarItem: 比較 (Comparison between Two Items) & どちら
instructionalDetails: AのほうがBより [Property] です; reverse order BよりAのほうが; comparative question AとBとどちらが [Property] ですか; prohibition of どちら/のほう for 3+ items.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 234-235 (PDF pp. 242-243, p242_printed234.png, p243_printed235.png). Verified comparative sentence structures, reverse particle order note, and どちら restrictions.

grammarItem: 形容詞/名詞 + の (Noun Substitute 'no')
instructionalDetails: Indefinite noun substitute の replacing understood items to avoid repetition (赤いの, 好きなの, メアリーさんの); retention of な for な-adjectives; strict prohibition against referring to people (use 人).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 235-236 (PDF pp. 243-244, p243_printed235.png, p244_printed236.png). Verified noun substitute rules, footnote 4 inanimate restriction, and な-adj retaining な.

grammarItem: 〜つもりだ / つもりです (Stated Personal Intention)
instructionalDetails: V(short present) + つもりだ/です for conscious personal future plan; negative plan V-ない + つもりです (or V-る + つもりはありません); past intention つもりでした (unrealized plan); social restriction against asking superiors.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 236 (PDF p. 244, p244_printed236.png). Verified short present connection, negative intention patterns, and unrealized intention with つもりでした.

grammarItem: 形容詞 + なる (Change of State: To Become)
instructionalDetails: Adverbial transformation before なる: い-adj (drop い) + くなる (暖かくなる, いい→よくなる); な-adj stem + になる (静かになる); Noun + になる (医者になる); explicit warning against *暖かになる; absolute vs relative change with より.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 236-237 (PDF pp. 244-245, p244_printed236.png, p245_printed237.png). Verified adverbial conjugation paradigms, *暖かになる trap warning, and relative change with より.

grammarItem: どこかに・どこにも・で (Indefinite Place Pronouns & Instrumental Particle)
instructionalDetails: どこか(へ/に) in affirmative clauses; どこにも / どこへも with negative predicates (preserves particles に/へ before も); instrumental で for transportation/tools; walking exception 歩いて行く (no で).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 237-238 (PDF pp. 245-246, p245_printed237.png, p246_printed238.png). Verified indefinite pronoun particle behavior, instrumental で usage, and walking exception.

grammarItem: 〜たい / 〜たくない (Expressing Desire to Do)
instructionalDetails: V-stem + たいです (conjugates like い-adj); direct object takes either を or が; long-held desires with 〜たいと思っています; third-person desires require quotation (〜と言っていました) or observation verb 〜たがっている (which takes ONLY を, never が).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 258-259 (PDF pp. 266-267, p266_printed258.png, p267_printed259.png). Verified object particle alternation (を/が), third-person 〜たがっている behavior, and prohibition against *が.

grammarItem: 〜たり〜たりする・や (Representative Activities & Non-Exhaustive Listing)
instructionalDetails: V-た + り、V-た + りする for non-exhaustive activities in no chronological sequence (tense on final する); Noun や Noun for non-exhaustive noun listing; contrastive は in negative sentences replacing を/が.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 259-261 (PDF pp. 267-269, p267_printed259.png, p268_printed260.png, p269_printed261.png). Verified non-exhaustive activity semantics, tense carried by final する, and noun linker や.

grammarItem: 〜ことがある (Past Experiential Aspect)
instructionalDetails: V-た + ことがある / あります for historical experience; negative 〜たことがありません; response etiquette with はい、あります (never *はい、そうです); Footnote 1 contrast between lack of experience (〜たことがない) vs pending expectation (まだ〜ていません); pairing with だけ.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 260-261 (PDF pp. 268-269, p268_printed260.png, p269_printed261.png). Verified past short form attachment, answer convention, and footnote 1 comparison with まだ〜ていません.

grammarItem: 〜んです (Explanatory Mode)
instructionalDetails: Short form + んです for explanations and clarifications; mandatory な insertion for nouns and な-adjectives in present affirmative (静かなんです, 学生なんです; ban on *だんです); invariant ending (preceding short form holds tense/polarity); どうしたんですか question etiquette with が subject marker; formal written のです and casual んだ.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 276-277 (PDF pp. 284-285, p284_printed276.png, p285_printed277.png). Verified explanatory mode mechanics, な insertion on nouns/な-adjectives, and question clarifications.

grammarItem: 〜すぎる (Excessiveness: Too Much / Overdoing)
instructionalDetails: V-stem / い-adj (drop い) / な-adj (drop な) + すぎる; regular Ru-verb conjugation; indicates unwelcome excess beyond proper degree (not a simple compliment); noun form 〜すぎ.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 278 (PDF p. 286, p286_printed278.png). Verified Ru-verb conjugation, adjective base attachment, and caution against using with compliments.

grammarItem: 〜ほうがいいです (Giving Advice: Had Better)
instructionalDetails: Advice asymmetry: affirmative advice uses past short form (V-た + ほうがいいです), negative advice uses present short form (V-ない + ほうがいいです); ban on *V-る + ほうがいいです for specific advice; pragmatic softening with よ/ね.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 278 (PDF p. 286, p286_printed278.png). Verified strict tense asymmetry between affirmative past advice and negative present advice.

grammarItem: 〜ので (Reason / Background Circumstance)
instructionalDetails: Clause(short form) + ので for objective reasons; contrast with から (more formal, courteous, objective circumstance); mandatory な insertion for nouns and な-adjectives in present affirmative (日曜日なので, いじわるなので; ban on *だので).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 279-280 (PDF pp. 287-288, p287_printed279.png, p288_printed280.png). Verified objective causal framing, comparison to から, and mandatory な insertion.

grammarItem: 〜なければいけません / なきゃいけません (Obligation: Must Do)
instructionalDetails: V-ない (drop い) + ければいけません (formal written) / なきゃいけません (colloquial spoken); double negative structural logic; past obligation with 〜いけませんでした.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 280 (PDF p. 288, p288_printed280.png). Verified negative stem attachment, double negative etymology, and spoken casual contractions.

grammarItem: 〜でしょう / 〜だろう (Conjecture & Probability: Probably)
instructionalDetails: Short form + でしょう for conjecture/probability; interrogative 〜でしょうか for polite tentative queries; paired with adverb たぶん; CRITICAL BAN on だ for nouns and な-adjectives (雨でしょう, トマトは野菜でしょう; strictly prohibited: *野菜だでしょう).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 280-281 (PDF pp. 288-289, p288_printed280.png, p289_printed281.png). Verified probability semantics, tentative polite query usage, and strict ban on だ.

grammarItem: 可能形 (Potential Verbs: Ability & Possibility)
instructionalDetails: Ru-verbs: -rareru (見られる, 食べられる; spoken ra-less -reru); U-verbs: -eru (行ける, 読める, 泳げる); irregulars: くる→こられる, する→できる; potential verbs conjugate as Ru-verbs; direct object を standardly switches to が (漢字が読める); できる takes が; other particles (に, で, へ) remain unchanged.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 26-28 (PDF pp. 34-36, p34_printed26.png, p35_printed27.png, p36_printed28.png). Verified potential conjugation paradigm, ra-less note, and を -> が particle alternation.

grammarItem: 〜し、〜し (Listing Multiple Parallel Reasons)
instructionalDetails: [Reason 1]し、[Reason 2]し、[Situation] for multiple parallel reasons; short form predicates; polite long forms allowed; single し implies additional unstated reasons; MANDATORY だ insertion for な-adjectives and nouns in present affirmative (親切だし, 学生だし; ban on bare stem *親切し).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 28-29 (PDF pp. 36-37, p36_printed28.png, p37_printed29.png). Verified multiple reason coordination and mandatory だ insertion for な-adjectives and nouns.

grammarItem: 〜そうです：様子 (Look like / Seem - Conjectural Appearance)
instructionalDetails: Adjective stem + そうです for conjectural appearance based on impressions; い-adj (drop い) + そうです; irregular いい→よさそう (ban on *いそう); な-adj (drop な) + そうです; negative なさそう / 〜そうじゃないです; verb stem + そうです; CRITICAL RESTRICTION against self-evident visual words (*きれいそう and *かわいいそう are prohibited; say きれいですね).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 29-30 (PDF pp. 37-38, p37_printed29.png, p38_printed30.png). Verified adjective stem attachments, いい→よさそう irregular, and explicit prohibition on visually self-evident adjectives like きれい.

grammarItem: 〜てみる (Trying Out an Action: Doing Something to See)
instructionalDetails: V-て + みる for doing something tentatively or testing the waters with unknown outcome; regular Ru-verb conjugation; ORTHOGRAPHY RULE: auxiliary 〜てみる is always written in hiragana (distinguishing from lexical 見る).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 30 (PDF p. 38, p38_printed30.png). Verified tentative experimental aspect, Ru-verb inflection, and hiragana-only orthography rule.

grammarItem: なら (Contextual Limitation Conditional: If It's X / As For X)
instructionalDetails: Noun + なら singles out an item from context with contrast and limitation (チリなら行きましたが、ブラジルは行ったことがありません); affirmative/positive assertion on the singled-out item; particle rule (Footnote 6): は, が, を are dropped before なら; に, で, から may be retained.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 31 (PDF p. 39, p39_printed31.png). Verified contrastive limitation semantics, positive context restriction, and particle dropping behavior.

grammarItem: 期間に回数 (Frequency over a Period: 〜に〜回)
instructionalDetails: (period) に (frequency / duration) framework (一週間に三回: three times a week; 一日に三時間: three hours a day); question pattern with (period) に何回 [V] ますか.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 31-32 (PDF pp. 39-40, p39_printed31.png, p40_printed32.png). Verified period framework and frequency counters.

grammarItem: ほしい (Expressing Desire for an Object: Want Something)
instructionalDetails: Noun が ほしい (desire for possession; conjugates like い-adj); first-person restriction (or second-person in questions); third person desires require quotation (〜と言っていた), probability (〜かもしれない), or derived verb ほしがる (takes ONLY を, never が; 友達をほしがっている); action desire uses V-たい.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 50-51 (PDF pp. 58-59, p58_printed50.png, p59_printed51.png). Verified object desire semantics, first-person restriction, third-person ほしがる behavior, and particle を constraint.

grammarItem: 〜かもしれない / 〜かもしんない (Epistemic Possibility: Might / May)
instructionalDetails: Short form + かもしれません for epistemic possibility (less certain than 〜でしょう); casual contractions 〜かもしんない and 〜かも; CRITICAL BAN on だ for nouns and な-adjectives in present affirmative (インド人かもしれない, 嫌いかもしれない; strictly prohibited: *だかもしれない).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 51-52 (PDF pp. 59-60, p59_printed51.png, p60_printed52.png). Verified possibility semantics, casual contractions, and strict ban on だ for nouns/な-adjectives.

grammarItem: あげる・くれる・もらう (Benefactive / Transaction Verbs of Giving & Receiving)
instructionalDetails: Three-way transaction orientation: あげる for outbound/staying away giving (giver は recipient に item を あげる); くれる for inbound giving toward speaker/family (giver は 私/family に item を くれる); もらう for subject receiving (recipient は giver に/から item を もらう; implies closer affinity to recipient).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 52-53 (PDF pp. 60-61, p60_printed52.png, p61_printed53.png). Verified directional giving paradigm, concentric psychological distance model, and in-group くれる rules.

grammarItem: 〜たらどうですか (Casual Advice / Suggestion: Why Don't You?)
instructionalDetails: V-た + らどうですか for advice/recommendation (casual: 〜たらどう？ / 〜たら？); pragmatic caution: can sound critical/reproachful; STRICT INVITATION BAN: cannot be used to extend invitations (use 〜ませんか instead; うちに来ませんか, not *来たらどうですか).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 54 (PDF p. 62, p62_printed54.png). Verified advice formation, potential disapproving tone caution, and explicit ban on invitations.

grammarItem: 数量＋も・しか〜ない (Quantity + も for Abundance / しか〜ない for Scarcity)
instructionalDetails: [Number] + も with affirmative for surprisingly large quantity ("as many as"); [Number] + しか with negative verb for lamented scarcity ("only / as few as"); contrast with neutral だけ (which can take affirmative verbs).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 54-55 (PDF pp. 62-63, p62_printed54.png, p63_printed55.png). Verified quantity emphasis particles, negative polarity requirement on しか, and comparison with だけ.

grammarItem: 意向形 (The Volitional Form: Casual Let's Do / Self-Resolve)
instructionalDetails: Ru-verbs: -yoo (食べよう, 見よう); U-verbs: final u shifts to o-row + う (行こう, 泳ごう, 待とう, 飲もう); irregulars: くる→こよう, する→しよう; casual equivalent of 〜ましょう; question pattern with か (手伝おうか: Shall I lend a hand?).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 74-75 (PDF pp. 82-83, p82_printed74.png, p83_printed75.png). Verified volitional conjugation paradigms across verb classes and offer/opinion questions with か.

grammarItem: 意向形 + と思っている / と思う (Firm Ongoing Determination: Intending To)
instructionalDetails: 意向形 + と思っている for ongoing firm determination already decided; 意向形 + と思う for decision made on the spot; contrast with present dictionary form + と思う (which conveys objective prediction rather than determined intention).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 75 (PDF p. 83, p83_printed75.png). Verified aspectual dichotomy between ongoing resolution (と思っている) and spontaneous decision (と思う), plus prediction contrast.

grammarItem: 〜ておく (Preparatory Action: Doing Something in Advance)
instructionalDetails: V-て + おく describes actions performed in advance in preparation for a future event; U-verb inflection; spoken casual contraction 〜ておく → 〜とく (予約しとく, 買っとく).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 76 (PDF p. 84, p84_printed76.png). Verified preparatory aspect semantics, U-verb conjugation, and spoken casual contraction 〜とく.

grammarItem: 連体修飾節 (Relative Clauses / Qualifying Nouns with Sentences)
instructionalDetails: Qualifier sentence in short form directly precedes modified noun without relative pronouns; INTERNAL SUBJECT RULE: subject inside relative clause is marked by が, never は (彼女がくれた本; ban on *彼女はくれた本); expression notes: 見える vs 見られる (spontaneous visibility vs active capability), 聞こえる vs 聞ける, and ordinal suffix 〜目.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 76-77 (PDF pp. 84-85, p84_printed76.png, p85_printed77.png). Verified relative clause syntax, internal subject が rule, and expression notes for 見える/見られる.

grammarItem: 〜てあげる・てくれる・てもらう (Benefactive Actions / Favors)
instructionalDetails: V-てあげる for favors done for others (retains verb particle slot, or uses [Person] のために if no slot exists); V-てくれる for favors done for the speaker/in-group; V-てもらう for receiving/persuading favors (beneficiary は benefactor に V-てもらう); acknowledging goodwill.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 96-98 (PDF pp. 104-106, p104_printed96.png, p105_printed97.png, p106_printed98.png). Verified benefactive action orientations, Footnote 1 のために rule, and grammatical case markings.

grammarItem: 〜ていただけませんか (Polite Request Hierarchy)
instructionalDetails: Politeness tiers for requests: V-ていただけませんか (most deferential, for professors, bosses, and strangers; derived from いただく) > V-てくれませんか (polite standard, roughly equal to 〜てください) > V-てくれない？ / V-て (casual peer request).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 98-99 (PDF pp. 106-107, p106_printed98.png, p107_printed99.png). Verified three-tier politeness hierarchy, derivation from いただく, and social context applications.

grammarItem: 〜といい (Hoping for Favorable Outcomes: I Hope That...)
instructionalDetails: Present short form + といい; pragmatic differentiation: wishing for oneself takes 〜といいんですが (softened expectation); wishing for listener takes 〜といいですね (encouragement / friendly support).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 99-100 (PDF pp. 107-108, p107_printed99.png, p108_printed100.png). Verified present short form connection and speaker (〜といいんですが) vs listener (〜といいですね) pragmatics.

grammarItem: 〜時（とき）の時制 (Tense Nuances in 'When' Clauses: V-る時 vs V-た時)
instructionalDetails: Relative completion controls tense: V-る時 when B occurs before/during A (出かける時鍵をかける); V-た時 when A is already completed before B occurs (中国に行った時お茶を買う); ongoing background with V-ている時; な-adj + な時; Noun + の時.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 100-102 (PDF pp. 108-110, p108_printed100.png, p109_printed101.png, p110_printed102.png). Verified relative tense mechanics, chronological diagrams, and adjectival/nominal connections.

grammarItem: 〜てすみませんでした / 〜なくてすみませんでした (Apologies)
instructionalDetails: V-て + すみませんでした for apologizing for actions taken; V-なくて + すみませんでした for apologizing for omissions/failures (drop い from ない and add くて); Footnote 8: past すみませんでした for clean break, present すみません for ongoing situation.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 102-103 (PDF pp. 110-111, p110_printed102.png, p111_printed103.png). Verified affirmative and negative apology paradigms and Footnote 8 tense nuances.

grammarItem: 〜そうです (Hearsay Report: I Heard That / Reportedly)
instructionalDetails: Short form + そうです for hearsay reports; contrast with Lesson 13 appearance; MANDATORY だ insertion for な-adjectives and nouns in present affirmative (親切だそうです, 学生だそうです; ban on *親切そうです which means appearance); invariant ending (Footnote 1); information source specified with [Source] によると (天気予報によると).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 118-119 (PDF pp. 126-127, p126_printed118.png, p127_printed119.png). Verified hearsay semantics, comparison table with appearance, mandatory だ on な-adjectives/nouns, and によると.

grammarItem: 〜って・みたいです (Casual Quotation & Resemblance/Inference)
instructionalDetails: 〜って as casual quotation/hearsay particle following short forms (忙しいって, 食べたって言ってた); 〜みたいです for resemblance to noun (Nounみたい: Colonel Sandersみたい) and inference from sensory observation (V-shortみたいです: 空いているみたいです: looks hungry; 降ったみたい: looks like it rained); な-adjective inflection.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 119, 122-123 (PDF pp. 127, 130-131, p127_printed119.png, p130_printed122.png, p131_printed123.png). Verified colloquial quotation 〜って and dual functions of みたいです.

grammarItem: 〜たら (Specific & Temporal Conditional: If / When / Once Done)
instructionalDetails: Past short form + ら (V-たら, かったら, だったら, なかったら); open condition, temporal sequence certainty ("once / when A is done, let's do B"), and contrary-to-fact counterfactuals (私が猫だったら); strict chronological rule: B cannot happen before A; natural dependency rule (Footnote 6: cannot mean "even if").
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 119-121 (PDF pp. 127-129, p127_printed119.png, p128_printed120.png, p129_printed121.png). Verified conditional formation table, temporal certainty vs hypothetical modes, and chronological constraints.

grammarItem: 〜なくてもいいです (Lack of Obligation: You Do Not Have To)
instructionalDetails: V-ない (drop い) + くて + もいいです for lack of obligation ("do not have to / need not do"); casual variants 〜なくてもいい and 〜なくていい.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 121 (PDF p. 129, p129_printed121.png). Verified negative te-form attachment, permission of omission semantics, and casual spoken forms.

grammarItem: 〜前に・〜てから (Temporal Sequence: Before Doing vs After Doing)
instructionalDetails: V(short present) + 前に for "before doing A, do B" (verb before 前に is strictly present tense, even in past sentences); V-て + から for "after doing A, do B" (also "ever since A happened"); expression note on 〜よね (shared mutual knowledge).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 122-123 (PDF pp. 130-131, p130_printed122.png, p131_printed123.png). Verified strict present tense before 前に, sequential V-てから, and Footnote 10 "ever since" nuance.

grammarItem: 自動詞 vs 他動詞 (Intransitive vs Transitive Verb Pairs)
instructionalDetails: Transitive verbs take object を (agent acting on object: ドアを開けた); intransitive verbs take subject が (object undergoing change: ドアが開いた); 10 essential pairs; aspectual behavior with 〜ている: transitive + ている = action in progress, intransitive + ている = resultant state (窓が開いている).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 140-141 (PDF pp. 148-149, p148_printed140.png, p149_printed141.png). Verified transitivity pairs table, case marking rules, and resultant state semantics with 〜ている.

grammarItem: 〜てしまう (Dual Aspect: Regret/Mishap vs Thorough Completion)
instructionalDetails: V-て + しまう for complete culmination ("finish reading completely") and unintended mishap / regret ("inadvertently lost bag"); Footnote 1 constraint (affirmative only, cannot express negated regret); spoken casual contractions: 〜てしまう → 〜ちゃう, 〜でしまう → 〜じゃう (忘れちゃった).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 141-142 (PDF pp. 149-150, p149_printed141.png, p150_printed142.png). Verified dual culmination/regret aspect, Footnote 1 affirmative-only rule, and spoken 〜ちゃう/〜じゃう contractions.

grammarItem: 〜と (Natural Consequence & Inevitable Conditional: When / If)
instructionalDetails: Clause A (short present) + と、Clause B for inevitable cause-and-effect ("whenever A happens, B follows"); Clause A is strictly present tense; Clause B cannot contain speaker volition, requests, suggestions, or commands; adjective outcomes typically use 〜くなる / 〜になる.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 142-143 (PDF pp. 150-151, p150_printed142.png, p151_printed143.png). Verified inevitable condition mechanics, strict present tense in Clause A, and ban on volitional expressions in Clause B.

grammarItem: 〜ながら (Simultaneous Concurrent Actions: While Doing)
instructionalDetails: V1 (masu-stem) + ながら、V2 for concurrent actions (V2 is main action, V1 is secondary); SAME AGENT CONSTRAINT: both actions must be performed by the exact same actor (cannot describe different actors; use 〜間に for different actors).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 143-144 (PDF pp. 151-152, p151_printed143.png, p152_printed144.png). Verified masu-stem connection, main vs secondary action focus, and strict same-agent constraint.

grammarItem: 〜ばよかった (Retrospective Regret: I Should Have Done)
instructionalDetails: Retrospective regret over missed alternatives: affirmative V(u->eba) + よかった ("I should have done"); negative V-なければよかった ("I should not have done"); expression note on 〜のおかげで (thanks to) and おかげさまで.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 144-145 (PDF pp. 152-153, p152_printed144.png, p153_printed145.png). Verified conditional -eba formation across verb classes, affirmative/negative regret, and おかげさまで expressions.

grammarItem: 尊敬語 (Honorific Speech: Special Verbs & Regular Formulas)
instructionalDetails: Exalts actions of superiors/guests; special verbs (いらっしゃる, 召し上がる, おっしゃる, なさる, ご覧になる, お休みになる, くださる); irregular -i polite endings (いらっしゃいます); compound verbs with -kuru (持っていらっしゃる); regular formula お + V-stem + になる; restriction against 1-syllable stems (見る, 寝る).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 164-165 (PDF pp. 172-173, g2_p172_printed164.png, g2_p173_printed165.png). Verified special verbs table, irregular -i conjugations note, Footnote 1 compound verbs rule, and regular お〜になる formula.

grammarItem: お + V-stem + ください (Polite Honorific Request / Respectful Advice)
instructionalDetails: Polite requests/advice in business/public announcements; native wago verbs use お + V-stem + ください (お取りください, お入りください); Sino-Japanese suru-compounds use ご + Noun + ください (ご注意ください, ご覧ください); restriction on 1-syllable stems.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 166 (PDF p. 174, g2_p174_printed166.png). Verified polite request formula お + V-stem + ください and Sino-Japanese prefix ご- rule.

grammarItem: 〜てくれてありがとう・〜てよかった (Gratitude & Emotional Relief)
instructionalDetails: Expressing gratitude for actions: casual 〜てくれてありがとう vs polite/superior 〜てくださってありがとうございました (negative: 〜ないでくれて); expressing emotional relief: affirmative 〜てよかった (glad it happened) vs negative 〜なくてよかった (glad it did not happen).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 167 (PDF p. 175, g2_p175_printed167.png). Verified gratitude hierarchy (〜てくれてありがとう vs 〜てくださってありがとうございました) and relief pairs (〜てよかった vs 〜なくてよかった).

grammarItem: 〜はずです (Logical Expectation: Supposed to Be)
instructionalDetails: Belief/deduction based on evidence/common sense; short forms + はずです; な-adj + なはずです; Noun + のはずです; prohibition on moral/legal duty contexts (must use べき); negative conviction 〜はずがない / はずはない.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 168-169 (PDF pp. 176-177, g2_p176_printed168.png, g2_p177_printed169.png). Verified logical expectation formation, な/の particle connections, and moral duty prohibition.

grammarItem: 丁重語・謙譲語 (Extra-Modest Speech & Humble Expressions)
instructionalDetails: 丁重語 exalts listener generally (参る, 申す, いたす, おる, ござる); 謙譲語 exalts specific recipient of action; regular formula お + V-stem + する (お持ちする) and ご + Noun + する (ご紹介する); special humble verbs (伺う, 差し上げる, お目にかかる).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 184-187 (PDF pp. 192-195, g2_p192_printed184.png to g2_p195_printed187.png). Verified extra-modest verbs table, humble formulas (お〜する / ご〜する), and distinction between listener deference vs recipient deference.

grammarItem: 〜ないで (Doing Something Without Doing X)
instructionalDetails: V-short negative + で for unperformed prerequisite/circumstance; critical tense rule: present 〜ないで is used for BOTH present and past sentences (never *なかったで); tense marked only on main final verb.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 188 (PDF p. 196, g2_p196_printed188.png). Verified formation V-ないで and strict ban on past marking inside the clause.

grammarItem: 文の中の疑問・という名前 (Embedded Questions & Noun Called X)
instructionalDetails: Embedded questions: Wh-word + short clause + か; Yes/No + かどうか; mandatory だ dropping on nouns and な-adjectives before か/かどうか; internal subject takes が; naming construction [Name] という [Noun].
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 188-190 (PDF pp. 196-198, g2_p196_printed188.png to g2_p198_printed190.png). Verified embedded Wh-question か, Yes/No かどうか, copula だ dropping rule, and という naming pattern.

grammarItem: 〜やすい・〜にくい (Easy to Do / Hard to Do)
instructionalDetails: V(masu-stem) + やすい (easy to V / prone to V); V(masu-stem) + にくい (hard/difficult to V); inflection identical to い-adjectives (〜やすくない, 〜やすかった, 〜にくかった); covers manageability and inherent propensity.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 190 (PDF p. 198, g2_p198_printed190.png). Verified masu-stem attachment, い-adjective inflection paradigm, and affirmative/negative usage.

grammarItem: 受身 (Passive Sentences: Direct, Suffering, and Adversity Passives)
instructionalDetails: Ru: -rareru, U: -areru, くる→こられる, する→される; conjugates as ru-verb; 3 passive types: direct passive, possessive/suffering passive ([Victim は] [Villain に] [Belonging を] V-passive), and intransitive adversity passive (雨に降られた); neutral/positive passives (誘われる, 尊敬される).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 210-212 (PDF pp. 218-220, g2_p218_printed210.png to g2_p220_printed212.png). Verified passive conjugation paradigm, adversity/suffering passive mechanics, and neutral passive examples.

grammarItem: 〜てある (Transitive Verb Resultant State: Deliberately Prepared)
instructionalDetails: V(transitive)-て + ある for intentional resultant state prepared in advance; entity takes が (予約がしてある, 窓が開けてある); aspectual distinction: transitive + ている (action in progress) vs intransitive + ている (natural state) vs transitive + てある (intentional prepared state).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 213 (PDF p. 221, g2_p221_printed213.png). Verified transitive resultant state formation, particle が marking, and contrast with 〜ておく and intransitive 〜ている.

grammarItem: 〜間に vs 〜間 (During a Moment vs Throughout the Entire Duration)
instructionalDetails: 〜間に marks momentary event B occurring within duration A (留守の間に友だちが来た); 〜間 marks continuous event B extending throughout the entire duration of A (寝ている間、ずっと本を読んだ); formation with V-ている and Noun + の.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 214 (PDF p. 222, g2_p222_printed214.png). Verified aspectual dichotomy between momentary 間に and continuous 間 with authentic textbook examples.

grammarItem: 形容詞＋する・〜てほしい (Deliberate Adjustment & Wanting Someone to Do)
instructionalDetails: い-adj drop い + くする / な-adj + にする (deliberately make/alter); contrast with spontaneous なる; [Person に] V-てほしい (want person to do); negative wish [Person に] V-ないでほしい (want person not to do).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 215 (PDF p. 223, g2_p223_printed215.png). Verified adjective + する alterations and 〜てほしい / 〜ないでほしい person marking with に.

grammarItem: 使役・使役＋授受 (Causative Sentences & Causative Benefactive)
instructionalDetails: Ru: -saseru, U: -aseru, くる→こさせる, する→させる; dual meaning (make do vs let do); case marking: transitive cast strictly takes に to avoid double-wo; intransitive cast takes を (coercion) or に (permission); causative + くれる (let/allow); humble permission request V-させてください.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 232-234 (PDF pp. 240-242, g2_p240_printed232.png to g2_p242_printed234.png). Verified causative conjugation paradigm, transitive double-wo avoidance rule, and causative + benefactive usage.

grammarItem: 〜なさい (Firm Command / Directive)
instructionalDetails: V(masu-stem) + なさい; authoritative non-negotiable instruction from parent to child, teacher to student, or written exam questions (読みなさい); strictly prohibited toward equals or superiors.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 234 (PDF p. 242, g2_p242_printed234.png). Verified masu-stem connection, sociopragmatic hierarchy, and authoritative directive examples.

grammarItem: 〜ば (The Hypothetical Conditional: If)
instructionalDetails: Affirmative: drop -u, add -eba; negative: drop -i from ない, add -ければ; い-adj: drop -i, add -ければ; な-adj/Noun: + なら; prerequisite condition naturally leading to consequence; implies desirable outcome; advice formula V-ばいい; prohibition on requests/commands in B when A is volitional.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 235-236 (PDF pp. 243-244, g2_p243_printed235.png, g2_p244_printed236.png). Verified conditional conjugation rules, positive consequence nuance, and contrast with たら.

grammarItem: 〜のに (Frustrated Concession: Even Though / In Spite Of)
instructionalDetails: Connects two facts holding contrary to expectation with emotion of disappointment/frustration; short forms + のに; mandatory な insertion on な-adjectives and nouns (好きなのに, 日曜日なのに); prohibition against commands or requests in clause B.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 236-237 (PDF pp. 244-245, g2_p244_printed236.png, g2_p245_printed237.png). Verified emotional concession semantics, mandatory な insertion rule on nouns/な-adj, and clause B constraint.

grammarItem: 〜のような・〜のように (Resemblance / Simile: Like / As If)
instructionalDetails: Noun A + のような + Noun B (adnominal simile: 天使のような人); Noun A + のように + Verb/Adjective (adverbial simile: 魚のように泳ぐ, 悟空のように強い); denotes metaphorical or physical resemblance.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 237-238 (PDF pp. 245-246, g2_p245_printed237.png, g2_p246_printed238.png). Verified noun modification with のような and verb/adjective modification with のように.

grammarItem: 使役受身 (Causative-Passive Sentences: Coerced Action)
instructionalDetails: Coerced into doing against one's will; Ru: -saserareru; U-verbs (non-su): contracted -asareru (行かされる, 待たされる, 飲まされる); す-verbs: -aserareru (話させられる); する→させられる; [Puppet は] [Puppet Master に] [Action を] V-causative-passive.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 254-255 (PDF pp. 262-263, g2_p262_printed254.png, g2_p263_printed255.png). Verified causative-passive conjugation table, contracted -asareru rule, non-contracting す-verbs constraint, and puppet master case marking.

grammarItem: 〜ても / 〜でも (Concessive Conditional: Even If / Even Though)
instructionalDetails: B holds true even in case of A; affirmative: V-ても, い-adj + くても, な-adj/Noun + でも; negative: V-なくても, い-adj + くなくても, な-adj/Noun + じゃなくても; contrast with たら (independence vs dependency).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 256-257 (PDF pp. 264-265, g2_p264_printed256.png, g2_p265_printed257.png). Verified concessive condition formation, negative forms table, and contrast with たら.

grammarItem: 〜ことにする vs 〜ことになる (Personal Decision vs Outside Emergence)
instructionalDetails: V(short present) + ことにする = personal internal conscious decision; V(short present) + ことになる = institutional arrangement or external emergence outside speaker agency; negative forms V-ないことにする.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 257-258 (PDF pp. 265-266, g2_p265_printed257.png, g2_p266_printed258.png). Verified contrast between personal conscious decision (ことにする) and institutional assignment (ことになる).

grammarItem: 〜ことにしている (Personal Habitual Policy / Rule)
instructionalDetails: V(short present aff/neg) + ことにしている = self-imposed sustained personal policy / habit ("make it a rule to do / make sure not to do"); denotes disciplined ongoing routine.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 258 (PDF p. 266, g2_p266_printed258.png). Verified regular habitual practice nuance and affirmative/negative habit examples.

grammarItem: 〜まで・〜方 (Until Event Coincides & Way of Doing / How to Do)
instructionalDetails: Clause A + まで (verb before まで is strictly short present affirmative: 雨がやむまで待った); contrast with deadline までに; V(masu-stem) + 方 (method noun: 使い方, 泳ぎ方); suru-compounds [Noun の] し方; object takes particle の (漢字の書き方).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 258-259 (PDF pp. 266-267, g2_p266_printed258.png, g2_p267_printed259.png). Verified まで present tense restriction and 〜方 masu-stem formation with mandatory の case marking.

grammarItem: 〜うちに (While State Lasts / Before Opportunity Slips)
instructionalDetails: Seizing transient window of opportunity before condition changes; Clause A is state; Clause B is strictly intentional volitional action (登りたい, 買おう); connections: Noun+の, な-adj+な, い-adj, V(dict/te-iru/nai) + うちに; negative V-ないうちに means "before X happens".
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 16 (PDF p. 39, skm3_pdf_39.png). Verified Section 1-1 rules, volitional clause B requirement, and negative V-ないうちに usage.

grammarItem: 〜うちに (Unnoticed Natural Evolution: Non-Volitional Change)
instructionalDetails: Change occurs naturally without speaker volition while continuous process unfolds ("before realizing it, became..."); Clause B strictly non-volitional (ban on requests/commands: *見ているうちに買いましょう is ungrammatical); connections: V(dict/te-iru/nai) + うちに.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 16 (PDF p. 39, skm3_pdf_39.png). Verified Section 1-2 rules, non-volitional clause B restriction, and gradual natural evolution examples.

grammarItem: 〜間 vs 〜間に (Continuous Duration vs Momentary Action)
instructionalDetails: 〜間 indicates that both situations hold continuously throughout the same duration; 〜間に indicates that a momentary action/event takes place inside the ongoing duration of Clause A; connections: Noun+の / V(dict/te-iru/nai) + 間/間に.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 16-17 (PDF pp. 39-40, skm3_pdf_39.png, skm3_pdf_40.png). Verified Section 2-1 and 2-2 aspectual distinction between sustained duration (間) and momentary interruption (間に).

grammarItem: 〜てからでないと / 〜てからでなければ (Not Until / Prerequisite)
instructionalDetails: V-てからでないと / でなければ establishes necessary prerequisite; Clause B strictly restricted to negative statements of impossibility, inability, or prohibition (入れません, 決められません, 判断できない).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 17 (PDF p. 40, skm3_pdf_40.png). Verified Section 3 formation, mandatory negative clause B constraint, and prerequisite logic.

grammarItem: 〜ところだ (Temporal Phase: Imminent, In the Midst, Just Finished)
instructionalDetails: Three distinct temporal phases: (1) V-辞書形+ところだ (just about to start); (2) V-ている+ところだ (right in the midst of); (3) V-た+ところだ (just this moment finished); mid-sentence case marking variations: ところへ, ところを, ところで.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 17 (PDF p. 40, skm3_pdf_40.png). Verified Section 4 tripartite aspectual conjugation and mid-sentence particle attachments (ところへ/を/で).

grammarItem: 〜とおりに / 〜どおりに (In Exact Accordance With / Just As)
instructionalDetails: Conformity with model/instruction; Noun + のとおりに vs direct Noun + どおりに with rendaku (予想どおり, 計画どおり, 指示どおり); Verb (dict/ta/te-iru) + とおりに; ban on connecting verbs with particle の (*言うのとおり).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 18 (PDF p. 41, skm3_pdf_41.png). Verified Section 1 formation rules, noun rendaku behavior (どおり), and verb direct attachment.

grammarItem: 〜によって / 〜によっては (Depending on / According to Differences)
instructionalDetails: Variation depending on condition; predicate collocations 違う, さまざまだ, 異なる; Noun + によっては pinpoints one extreme/singular outcome from among possibilities (中止になることもある).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 18 (PDF p. 41, skm3_pdf_41.png). Verified Section 2 variation semantics and the distinguishing role of 〜によっては.

grammarItem: 〜たびに (Every Single Time / Invariable Recurrence)
instructionalDetails: Recurring invariable co-occurrence; Noun + の / V(dict) + たびに; strict bans: (1) no everyday matter-of-course habits (*朝起きるたびに顔を洗う), (2) neither clause can describe a static state.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 19 (PDF p. 42, skm3_pdf_42.png). Verified Section 3 rules and explicit textbook footnote banning matter-of-course everyday habits and static states.

grammarItem: (〜ば)〜ほど (Proportional Correlation: The More... The More...)
instructionalDetails: Parallel proportional increase; V-ば V-dictほど; A-ければ A-いほど; A-なら A-なほど; Noun+ほど; optional ellipsis of initial conditional clause (考えるほど); parallel degree semantics.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 19 (PDF p. 42, skm3_pdf_42.png). Verified Section 4 four-part conjugation paradigm (verb, i-adj, na-adj, noun) and proportional degree mechanics.

grammarItem: 〜ついでに (While at It / Incidental Secondary Action)
instructionalDetails: Seizing opportunity of primary action A to do secondary action B; Noun + の / Verb (dict/ta) + ついでに; strict priority: A is the primary planned goal, B is the opportunistic secondary action.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 19 (PDF p. 42, skm3_pdf_42.png). Verified Section 5 formation rules, primary-versus-secondary priority constraints, and authentic examples.

grammarItem: 〜くらいだ / 〜ほどだ (Expressing Extreme Degree: To the Extent That)
instructionalDetails: Extreme metaphorical degree using illustrative unactualized example; Noun / Verb / い-adj / な-adj+な + くらいだ/ほどだ; idiomatic 〜かと思うほど (so intense I even wondered if); degree modification of predicates.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 22 (PDF p. 45, skm3_pdf_45.png). Verified Section 1 degree formation, illustrative unactualized comparison semantics, and idiomatic 〜かと思うほど usage.

grammarItem: 〜くらい…はない / 〜ほど…はない (Subjective Superlative: Nothing Beats X)
instructionalDetails: Subjective superlative assertion; Noun + くらい/ほど + Noun はない (or いない); speaker's personal subjective conviction; strict ban on stating objective geographical/factual superlatives (*富士山ほど高い山はない is unnatural).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 22 (PDF p. 45, skm3_pdf_45.png). Verified Section 2 formation, subjective judgment constraint, and contrast with factual superlatives.

grammarItem: 〜くらいなら / 〜ぐらいなら (Rather Than Suffer X, Prefer Y)
instructionalDetails: V(辞書形) + くらいなら / ぐらいなら; rejects undesirable option X in favor of preferred alternative Y; Clause B concludes with 〜方がいい, 〜方がましだ, or 〜たい; subjective value hierarchy.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 23 (PDF p. 46, skm3_pdf_46.png). Verified Section 3 formation rules, preference predicate requirements (〜方がましだ), and authentic textbook examples.

grammarItem: 〜に限る (Nothing Beats / Best Choice)
instructionalDetails: Noun / Verb (dict/nai) + に限る; speaker's subjective personal conviction that X is the absolute best method or choice; prohibition on objective factual laws or scientific statements; affirmative and negative policy formulations.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 23 (PDF p. 46, skm3_pdf_46.png). Verified Section 4 formation rules, subjective advice nuance, and negative policy usage (しないに限る).

grammarItem: 〜反面 (On the Flip Side: Coexisting Contradictory Aspects)
instructionalDetails: Coexistence of contradictory sides (pros/cons) within the same entity/situation; Plain form (+ な/である for な-adj, + である for Noun) + 反面; core constraint: both halves must describe the same subject/situation.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 24 (PDF p. 47, skm3_pdf_47.png). Verified Section 2 formation, dual aspect coexistence semantics, and same-entity constraint.

grammarItem: 〜かわりに (In Exchange For / Compensation / Instead Of)
instructionalDetails: Three functions: (1) trade-off compensation ("disadvantage A, but in return advantage B"), (2) exchange of favors, (3) proxy substitution ("in place of"); Plain form (+ な for な-adj, + の for Noun) + かわりに.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 25 (PDF p. 48, skm3_pdf_48.png). Verified Section 4 formation rules, trade-off compensation semantics, and proxy substitution mechanics.

grammarItem: 〜に対して (In Contrast To / While X Is..., Y Is...)
instructionalDetails: Contrasts two different entities or opposing factual realities; Noun + に対して / Clause (plain form + の) + に対して; contrast with 反面 (two entities vs single entity duality).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 24 (PDF p. 47, skm3_pdf_47.png). Verified Section 1 contrast mechanics and syntactic connection with noun and nominalized clauses.

grammarItem: 〜に比べて (Compared With / Relative To)
instructionalDetails: Noun + に比べて / に比べると; uses noun as comparative baseline standard to evaluate a difference in degree or quality; comparative degree measurement.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 24-25 (PDF pp. 47-48, skm3_pdf_47.png, skm3_pdf_48.png). Verified comparative degree evaluation and noun attachment rules.

grammarItem: 〜一方で・〜というより (Dual Perspectives & Nuance Rephrasing)
instructionalDetails: 〜一方で presents dual concurrent opposing phenomena ("while A, at the same time B"); 〜というより indicates nuance correction ("rather than X, it is more like Y; often paired with むしろ).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 24-25 (PDF pp. 47-48, skm3_pdf_47.png, skm3_pdf_48.png). Verified Section 3 一方で dual trend semantics and Section 5 というより nuance correction rules.

grammarItem: 〜ためだ / 〜ために (Objective Cause: Due to / Owing to)
instructionalDetails: Objective cause/consequence; formal register; Noun + の / Plain form (+ な/である for な-adj, + の/である for Noun) + ため(に) / ためだ; strict prohibition on requests, commands, or volitions in clause B.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 30 (PDF p. 53, skm3_pdf_53.png). Verified Section 1 formation, formal objective causal semantics, and prohibition on commands/requests.

grammarItem: 〜によって・〜による：原因 (Cause & Agency: Due to / Caused by)
instructionalDetails: Noun + によって (clause modifier) / Noun + による + Noun (noun modifier); specifies external objective phenomena/disasters as cause; formal reporting register; ban on states and requests.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 30 (PDF p. 53, skm3_pdf_53.png). Verified Section 2 causal agency rules, noun modifier による vs clause modifier によって, and documentary tone.

grammarItem: 〜ことから (Origin of Name, Judgment, or Fact)
instructionalDetails: Observable fact serves as origin of name or clue for deduction; Plain form (+ な/である for な-adj, + である for Noun) + ことから; clause B expresses naming or discovery/judgment (分かった, 呼ばれている); ban on volition.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 30 (PDF p. 53, skm3_pdf_53.png). Verified Section 3 naming origin and deductive basis rules.

grammarItem: 〜おかげで vs 〜せいで (Grace of / Due to Fault of)
instructionalDetails: 〜おかげで = gratitude for positive outcome ("thanks to"); 〜せいで = blame for negative result ("due to fault of"); Noun + の / Plain form (+ な for な-adj) + おかげで/せいで; prohibition on commands/requests.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 31 (PDF p. 54, skm3_pdf_54.png). Verified Section 4 positive gratitude vs negative blame polarity and ban on commands.

grammarItem: 〜のだから / 〜んだから (Since It Is an Acknowledged Reality)
instructionalDetails: Mutual acknowledged reality; Plain form (+ な for な-adj/Noun) + のだから/んだから; distinctive rule: clause B explicitly features speaker judgments, advice, directives, or commands (やりなさい, 当然だ).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 31 (PDF p. 54, skm3_pdf_54.png). Verified Section 5 acknowledged reality semantics and unique permission of commands/requests in clause B.

grammarItem: 〜ては / 〜では (Negative Inevitable Consequence)
instructionalDetails: Condition A inevitably produces negative outcome B; V-て形 + は / い形くて + は / な形・名 + では / 普通形 + のでは; strict prohibition on speaker volitions, requests, invitations, or commands in clause B.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 32 (PDF p. 55). Verified Section 2 negative inevitable consequence rules and strict ban on volitional/imperative conclusions.

grammarItem: 〜さえ〜ば / 〜さえ〜なら (Sole Sufficient Minimum Prerequisite)
instructionalDetails: Indicates the single minimum condition that guarantees outcome; Noun + さえ + V-ば/い形ければ/な形なら/名なら or V-ます語幹 + さえすれば; semantics of 'if only this is met, nothing else is required'.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 33 (PDF p. 56). Verified Section 3 formation with Noun + さえ and V-stem + さえすれば, plus minimum condition semantics.

grammarItem: たとえ〜ても / たとえ〜でも (Hypothetical Concession: Even Granting X)
instructionalDetails: Hypothetical concession; たとえ + V-ても / い形くて + も / な形・名 + でも; outcome holds steadfastly regardless of hypothetical condition.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 33 (PDF p. 56). Verified Section 4 hypothetical concession rules with たとえ.

grammarItem: 〜なら (Context Premise) & 〜ば・〜たら・〜なら (Counterfactual Past)
instructionalDetails: Comprehensive conditional coverage: (1) 〜（の）なら based on listener's context/statements, followed by advice/volition/requests; (2) Counterfactual past conditionals (〜ば/たら + 〜たのに/のだが/ものを) expressing unrealized outcomes contrary to fact.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 32-33 (PDF pp. 55-56). Verified Section 1 context premise rules and Section 5 counterfactual past expressions.

grammarItem: 〜ということだ・〜とのことだ (Formal Transmission of Reported Speech)
instructionalDetails: Plain form + ということだ / とのことだ; slightly formal reporting register; source indicated by 〜によると/によれば; 〜とのことだ preferred when relaying personal messages, letters, or direct spoken statements.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 36 (PDF p. 59). Verified Section 1 formation with 〜によると and personal relay function of 〜とのことだ.

grammarItem: 〜と言われている (Received Opinion / Widespread Public Belief)
instructionalDetails: Plain form + と言われている; indicates widespread received opinion / societal consensus; no specific individual speaker needed as subject.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 36 (PDF p. 59). Verified Section 2 public consensus semantics and example sentences.

grammarItem: 〜とか・〜って・〜という (Hearsay Spectrum: Casual Gossip to Written Lore)
instructionalDetails: Three distinct registers of hearsay: (1) 〜とか for unconfirmed rumors; (2) 〜って as casual conversational shortcut; (3) 〜という as formal written/historical report.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 37 (PDF p. 60). Verified Sections 3, 4, 5 stylistic spectrum and omission of reporting verbs in casual って.

grammarItem: 〜わけがない / 〜わけはない (There Is Absolutely No Way That...)
instructionalDetails: Plain form (な-adj + な/である, Noun + の/である) + わけがない/わけはない; speaker's conviction of absolute impossibility based on logical evidence; rhetorical double negative (嬉しくないわけがない).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 38 (PDF p. 61). Verified Section 1 formation, strong negation conviction, and double negation rhetoric.

grammarItem: 〜とは限らない (Partial Truth: Not Necessarily the Case)
instructionalDetails: Plain form (な-adj (だ), Noun (だ)) + とは限らない; rejects universal validity/stereotypes; frequently pairs with 必ずしも (not necessarily), いつも (always), or 〜からといって.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 38 (PDF p. 61). Verified Section 2 partial truth semantics and pairing with 必ずしも.

grammarItem: 〜わけではない / 〜というわけではない (It Doesn't Mean That... / Partial Negation)
instructionalDetails: Plain form (な-adj + な/である, Noun + な/である/の) + わけではない/というわけではない; clarifies that while circumstances suggest X, reality is qualified or partially negated.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 39 (PDF p. 62). Verified Section 3 partial negation rules and polite conversational qualification.

grammarItem: 〜ないことはない / 〜ないこともない (Double Negative Litotes: It's Not Impossible)
instructionalDetails: V-ない / い形くない / な形でない / 名でない + ことはない/こともない; double negation expressing mild affirmative possibility or qualified concession.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 39 (PDF p. 62). Verified Section 4 double negative litotes formation and mild affirmation semantics.

grammarItem: 〜ことは〜が (Concession with Reservation / True, But...)
instructionalDetails: Predicate (plain) + ことは + Predicate (plain/polite) + が; concedes that X is true while placing primary communicative focus on contrasting reservation or limitation in clause B.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 39 (PDF p. 62). Verified Section 5 repetitive predicate concession syntax and contrastive focus.

grammarItem: 〜がる / 〜がっている (Third-Person Observable Sensations & Desires)
instructionalDetails: Adjective stem / V-たい stem + がる/がっている; reports observable outward behavior and physical manifestations of third-person emotions, sensations, and desires.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 44 (PDF p. 67). Verified third-person observable emotion semantics and behavioral manifestations.

grammarItem: 〜てほしい・〜てもらいたい (Desire for Action by Another Person)
instructionalDetails: Person に + V-て/ないで + ほしい/もらいたい; desire for another person's actions or forbearance; functions as request in direct address.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 44 (PDF p. 67). Verified Section 1 formation, external agent targeting, and public forbearance requests.

grammarItem: 〜（さ）せてほしい・〜（さ）せてもらいたい (Desire for Permission / Leave to Act)
instructionalDetails: V-causative て + ほしい/もらいたい/いただきたい; speaker seeks permission or leave to perform an action themselves ('let me do'); crucial distinction from causative commands.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 44-45 (PDF pp. 67-68). Verified Section 2 causative permission structures and professional polite applications.

grammarItem: 〜といい・〜ばいい・〜たらいい (Hopes Outside Direct Control & Gentle Recommendations)
instructionalDetails: Plain non-past + といい / conditional ば/たら + いい; (1) Hopes regarding outcomes outside speaker volitional control; (2) Gentle advice/recommendation urging action.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 45 (PDF p. 68). Verified Section 3 non-volitional wishing conditions and gentle advisory usage.

grammarItem: 〜べきだ / 〜べきではない / 〜べきだった (Moral Duty & Past Regret)
instructionalDetails: V-辞書形 + べきだ/べきではない (する→すべきだ/するべきだ); moral/ethical duty based on speaker conscience; past form 〜べきだった expresses deep regret and self-reproach.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 47 (PDF p. 70). Verified Section 3 moral obligation semantics, past regret rules, and formation with すべきだ.

grammarItem: 〜によると / 〜によれば (According to Source of Information)
instructionalDetails: Source Noun + によると/によれば; pairs with evidential/hearsay endings (〜そうだ, 〜とのことだ, 〜らしい); formal journalistic and objective citation.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 36 & p. 46 (PDF p. 59 & p. 69). Verified formal attribution function and pairing with hearsay predicates.

grammarItem: 命令・禁止・〜こと (Imperatives, Prohibitions & Written Directives)
instructionalDetails: V-imperative (書け, 見ろ, しろ, 来い); V-dict + な (prohibition); V-dict/ない + こと (formal written directives on rules and examination papers).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 46 (PDF p. 69). Verified Section 1 spoken imperatives/prohibitions and Section 2 written rubric directives with 〜こと.

grammarItem: 〜たらどうか (Suggestions, Recommendations & Mild Reproach)
instructionalDetails: V-たら + どうか / どうですか / どう; gentle advice recommending a course of action; also used critically to challenge a complainer ('why don't you do it yourself?').
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 47 (PDF p. 70). Verified Section 4 gentle advice and critical reproach usage.

grammarItem: 〜(よ)うとする / 〜(よ)うとしない (Inception, Attempt & Stubborn Refusal)
instructionalDetails: V-意向形 + とする/としたら (inception on verge of action; exertion attempt); negative 〜(よ)うとしない (third-party complete lack of will or stubborn refusal).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 51 (PDF p. 74). Verified Section 3 inception semantics, interrupted attempts, and third-person negative refusal rules.

grammarItem: 〜ようにする / 〜ようにしている (Conscious Effort & Habitual Endeavor)
instructionalDetails: V-dict / V-ない + ようにする/ようにしている; conscious effort to achieve a purpose; ongoing lifestyle endeavor.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 50 (PDF p. 73). Verified Section 2 deliberate endeavor rules and ongoing behavioral mindfulness.

grammarItem: 〜ことにする / 〜ことにしている (Personal Decision & Ongoing Habitual Policy)
instructionalDetails: V-dict / V-ない + ことにする/ことにしている; conscious personal choice; ongoing disciplined personal policy/rule.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 50 (PDF p. 73). Verified Section 1 decision-making structures and self-imposed ongoing code of conduct.

grammarItem: 〜（の）つもりだ (Subjective Belief Contrary to Fact & Arrogant Assumptions)
instructionalDetails: Plain form (な-adj な, Noun の) + つもりだ/つもりでいる/つもりだった; subjective conviction/intent held in mind regardless of reality; past mistaken assumptions; criticism of overconfidence.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 51 (PDF p. 74). Verified Section 4 subjective belief semantics, mistaken assumptions with 〜たつもりだった, and rebuke usage.

grammarItem: 尊敬語: お〜になる / ご〜になる / 特別動詞 (Respectful Language - Elevating Others)
instructionalDetails: Elevates actions of superiors/guests; special irregular verbs (いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, 召し上がる, ご覧になる, ご存知だ, なさる, くださる); regular formula お+V-stem+になる, ご+Noun+になる, passive respectful forms.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 52 (PDF p. 75). Verified Section 1 special honorific verbs, regular formulas, and ban on self-elevation.

grammarItem: 謙譲語I: お〜する / ご〜する / 特別動詞 (Humble Language 1 - Recipient Directed)
instructionalDetails: Lowers speaker's actions relative to esteemed recipient; special verbs (伺う, 申し上げる, 拝見する, お目にかかる, 存じ上げる, いただく, 差し上げる); regular formula お+V-stem+する/いたす, ご+Noun+する/いたす.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 52-53 (PDF pp. 75-76). Verified Section 2 recipient-directed deference, special humble forms, and regular formulas.

grammarItem: 謙譲語II（丁重語）・丁寧語 (Humble Language 2 & Polite Forms)
instructionalDetails: Listener-directed modest speech (参る, おる, 申す, いたす, ござる) and polite forms (です, ます, ございます); essential for business phone etiquette and Uchi/Soto distinctions.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 53 (PDF p. 76). Verified Section 3 Teichougo listener-oriented forms and Section 4 polite existentials.

grammarItem: 助詞の整理 A: こそ・さえ・でも・くらい・まで・など (Nuanced Particle Systematization)
instructionalDetails: Comprehensive particle systematization: こそ (resolute focus), さえ (extreme minimum), でも (proposal/broad scope), くらい (minimum baseline/approximation), まで (unexpected inclusion), など/なんか/なんて (disdain/modesty).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 58-59 (PDF pp. 81-82). Verified comparative particle taxonomy, multiple functional senses, and authentic exercise patterns.

grammarItem: 助詞の整理 B: について・に対して・によって・にとって・として (Compound Postposition Systematization)
instructionalDetails: Comprehensive compound particle taxonomy: について (theme/content), に対して (target of attitude / contrast), によって (passive agent / means / cause / variation), にとって (evaluating perspective), として (capacity/role).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 62-63 (PDF pp. 85-86). Verified 5 compound postpositions, semantic contrasts, noun-modifying forms (〜に対する, 〜にとっての, 〜としての), and exercise drills.

grammarItem: 〜ところだった (On the Very Verge Of / Narrowly Averted Near-Miss)
instructionalDetails: V-dict + ところだった; pairs with もう少しで or 危うく; indicates an undesirable near-miss crisis that was averted at the last fraction of a second.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 66 (PDF p. 89). Verified near-miss semantics, pairing with 危うく/もう少しで, and non-occurrence of the event.

grammarItem: 名詞化の整理 C: 「こと」と「の」 (Nominalizers: Abstract Content vs Sensory Perception)
instructionalDetails: Comparative systematization: こと for noun definition (〜は…ことだ) and grammar formulas; の for direct sensory perception (見る, 聞こえる, 感じる) and adjective evaluations (〜のは便利だ/難しい); もの for tangible physical objects.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 66-67 (PDF pp. 89-90). Verified nominalizer distinction rules across 4 operational domains.

grammarItem: 〜ように (Purpose Clause: Non-Volitional Objective)
instructionalDetails: Non-volitional verb (potential, intransitive, state verb) / V-ない + ように; expresses purpose towards which action is directed; strict contrast with volitional 〜ために.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 71 (PDF p. 94). Verified non-volitional verb constraint before purpose ように and authentic listening/note-taking examples.

grammarItem: 「よう」の整理 D: ようだ・ように (Metaphor, Premise, Indirect Directive & Prayer)
instructionalDetails: Fourfold operational spectrum of よう: (1) Metaphor and comparison (〜のようだ/ように); (2) Shared knowledge premise (ご存知のように); (3) Indirect imperative/command (〜ように言う); (4) Earnest prayer/wishing formula (〜ますように).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 70-71 (PDF pp. 93-94). Verified 4 operational domains of grammatical forms using よう.

grammarItem: 〜わけにはいかない (Inability to Act Due to Moral/Social Inhibition)
instructionalDetails: V-dict + わけにはいかない; cannot afford to act due to social morals, duty, or conscience; subject usually 1st person; strict contrast with physical inability (〜ことができない).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 74 (PDF p. 97). Verified textbook mandate that わけにはいかない expresses psychological/ethical inhibition rather than physical inability.

grammarItem: 「わけ」の整理 E: わけだ・ないわけにはいかない・わけがない・わけではない
instructionalDetails: Complete taxonomy of わけ: natural conclusion/enlightenment (わけだ, paired with 道理で), moral obligation (ないわけにはいかない), impossibility conviction (わけがない), and partial negation (わけではない).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 74-75 (PDF pp. 97-98). Verified full comparative spectrum of わけ across logical, ethical, and epistemic modalities.

grammarItem: 「ばかり」の使い方 F: ばかり・てばかりいる・ばかりか・ばかりだ・たばかりだ
instructionalDetails: Comprehensive taxonomy of ばかり across 5 operational domains: exclusive bias (Nばかり), habitual indulgence with reproach (Vてばかりいる), escalating addition (ばかりか), worsening trend / ready state (V辞書形ばかりだ), and subjective recency (Vたばかりだ vs Vたところだ).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 80-81 (PDF pp. 103-104). Verified complete 5-way functional spectrum of ばかり and contrast with たところだ.

grammarItem: 〜ことになっている (Customary Rule, Schedule, or Standing Regulation)
instructionalDetails: V-dict / V-ない + ことになっている; institutional regulations, laws, scheduled appointments, and customary agreements; strict contrast with personal habit (〜ことにしている).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 84-85 (PDF pp. 107-108). Verified systematic rule/custom domain of ことになっている versus intentional personal agency.

grammarItem: 「する」・「なる」の整理 G: 意志的行為 vs 客観的推移
instructionalDetails: Comprehensive 5-way systematic taxonomy contrasting human intentional agency (する) with objective outcome/state change (なる): state shift, decision, habit/rule, effort/ability, and mechanical design (〜ようになっている).
